title: compressor_modulation=on_off is read as modulating: the declared on/off pump gets unclamped sub-p_min plans
claim: thermal_model.declared_modulation maps COMPRESSOR_MODULATION_ON_OFF to True (modulating) instead of False, so a user declaring an on/off compressor gets clamp_planned_levels False on every set-point unit, and the solve prices 32 of 96 steps at levels in (0, p_min) the pump cannot run; auto on the same surface clamps (0 such steps).
mechanism: Both explicit select values return True; the docstring and the options page say on_off -> False. Every reader inherits it: levels_clamped/duty_cycle_realizable (the plan's level law), learner_unmetered (the house learner's freeze) and probe_install(...).on_off. The explicit declaration is therefore weaker than leaving the key on auto.

evidence.unit: cells (of 9) whose derived clamp contradicts the declared modulation
evidence.machine: box B5 (shared compute box, linux x86_64, venv-ci python 3.14)

perturbation.change: thermal_model.py declared_modulation: `True if mode == const.COMPRESSOR_MODULATION_ON_OFF` -> `False if mode == const.COMPRESSOR_MODULATION_ON_OFF` (harness --perturb, private copy)

metric_definition: Per space_setpoint_unit x compressor_modulation cell, 1 if from_mapping(cfg).clamp_planned_levels != declared (on_off True, modulating False, auto = probe); summed over 9 cells.
phenomenon_property: A declared on_off compressor plans every step at 0 or in [p_min, p_max] on every write surface; modulating opts out; auto follows the probe.

null_control.value: auto and modulating cells: clamp_mismatch 0 on all 6
